fields.statement: Verifier at a30953d0: go test ./cmd/rhiza -run TestScripts/run-status passes; its hand-written journal (alpha cycle 1 failed, cycle 2 open) prints '- alpha (step review): open in cycle 2 (cycle 1 failed)' and --json has no check-level outcome. Rebuilt the binary and ran the same journal in a scratch repo: text matches, JSON check object has open_cycle 2 / prior_outcome failed and no outcome, cycle 1 keeps outcome failed. TestChecksSummaryCountsOpenCycleRunning (liveapp) passes: an open-cycle check with empty outcome counts '1 running'. TestOpenCycleReadsOpen (api) passes: runCheckInfo leaves outcome empty, reviewSummary heads '### alpha: open', and a judged cycle 2 restores outcome passed. Read the diff: CheckOutcome/CheckOpen in internal/run/journal.go now feed run status, run summary and checksStatus. make check exits 0.
